note: gnomon's reading of conformance/toml_looser.toml, which is NOT valid TOML 1.0. gnomon accepts it; a spec parser refuses the whole file. The consequence is that a .gnomon/ surface can be written which gnomon loads and no other TOML tool will open. 'toml_refusal' is what Python 3.12 tomllib said when handed this file, recorded offline on 2026-09-01; nothing in CI re-runs it. Documentation of a limit, not endorsement.
